Dad just bought GTA 6... for the whole family to share?!
One copy. Seventy-nine ninety-nine. And Dad is far from the only one paying.
On its first day, November nineteenth, Grand Theft Auto Six brought in about three point seven nine billion dollars in retail sales, Take-Two says.
Thirty-two and a half million copies were sold before the game even came out.
That first day was about four point seven times GTA Five's first day back in 2013, around eight hundred million dollars.
But here's the catch. That three point seven nine billion is what shoppers spent. Stores and console makers take a cut, so Take-Two keeps less.
So Dad's eighty bucks gets split too?
